title: The same legacy player behind an object adapter and a class adapter

cases.says: Both adapters answer play("song.mp3") with the legacy player's "Playing MP3: song.mp3" and report their own player type.
Given a subclass of LegacyAudioPlayer that overrides playMp3, the object adapter returns what that subclass returns.
A subclass of AudioClassAdapter that overrides playMp3 changes what play returns, because the class adapter calls its own inherited method.
The adapters pass the filename on untouched: " song.mp3" keeps its space, and a blank name reaches the legacy player, which throws IllegalArgumentException.
